domain_restrictions: n is an integer with n > 1
t is a real number with (n-1)/n <= t and t < 1 (lower bound inclusive, upper bound strict)
k is an integer with 1 <= k and k <= n
floor is the greatest integer less than or equal to its real input
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For every integer n with n > 1, for every real t with (n-1)/n <= t < 1, and for every integer k with 1 <= k <= n, the greatest integer less than or equal to k times t equals k minus 1.
quantifier_order: for all t, with (n-1)/n <= t and t < 1
for all k, with 1 <= k and k <= n

variables.name: n
variables.role: outer universally quantified parameter, with lower bound n > 1

variables.name: t
variables.role: universally quantified parameter depending on n, constrained by (n-1)/n <= t < 1

variables.name: k
variables.role: universally quantified index constrained by 1 <= k <= n

statement_nl: For every integer n>1 and every real number t with (n-1)/n <= t < 1, one has floor(k*t) = k-1 for every integer k with 1 <= k <= n.
